title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with investment and innovation, as companies pivot to meet both defense and commercial demands. Meanwhile, the specter of regulatory challenges looms large over ambitious satellite projects.

themes.title: SpaceX's Growth Trajectory
themes.body: With Starship as its centerpiece, SpaceX is positioning itself for a significant leap forward. The recent IPO filing reveals just how much the company is banking on this ambitious rocket.

themes.title: Defense Budgets on the Rise
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup has added $1.4 billion to space resilience, signaling a renewed focus on national security in space. This could be a boon for companies like Anduril and L3Harris as they vie for contracts.

themes.title: Satellite Constellation Investments
themes.body: LatConnect 60 is ramping up investments for its SWIR satellite constellation, aligning with AUKUS objectives. This reflects a broader trend where nations are prioritizing advanced satellite capabilities.

themes.title: Hypersonic Hiccups Continue
themes.body: The hypersonic glide-vehicle test has slipped yet again, marking the third consecutive quarter of delays. This raises questions about the pace of innovation in a field that many consider crucial for future defense strategies.
